Why every website deserves a good night’s rest

By A. Writer · 6 min read

Bright pages at night are hard on the eyes. A good dark mode keeps a site’s character: links stay blue, highlights still pop, and the brand color remains recognizable.

Contrast is preserved, and nothing important disappears.
function goodnight(page) { return "dark"; }

Note: this page has no dark mode of its own.
